package.name: Invoice check
package.purpose: Compare a supplier invoice with its purchase order, prepare a short review summary, and add a matching invoice to the local payment list only after employee approval.

inputs.label: Supplier invoice
inputs.description: Upload the supplier invoice for this review.

inputs.label: Purchase order
inputs.description: Upload the purchase order corresponding to the invoice.

rules.text: Compare the invoice with the purchase order and flag any difference in quantities, prices, or totals. Show the amount and issues in a short review summary. Ask for employee approval before adding a matching invoice to the payment list.

deliverables: A short invoice review summary showing the amount and any issues.
A simulated local payment-list entry for a matching invoice only after employee approval.
exceptions: Missing, unreadable, or ambiguous documents or amounts are reported in the review summary and require clarification; they are not added to the payment list.
Any difference in quantity, unit price, line amount, or document total is reported and prevents the invoice from being treated as a match.
The summary is always reviewed by an employee; invoices with issues are not added to the payment list.
package.approval: An employee must review the summary and approve a matching invoice before it is added to the simulated local payment list. Do not approve an invoice with differences or unresolved document issues.
assumptions: Differences are assessed by exact comparison of the values shown; no tolerance or rounding rule was supplied.
The payment list is a simulated local destination, not a payment instruction or transfer.
Duplicate prevention uses the actual supplier name and invoice number; if the invoice number is absent, it uses a deterministic identity derived from the input files.

This reviewed starter supports one invoice and one purchase order, each a one-page searchable PDF in the labelled starter layout with explicit SKU rows. Ambiguous duplicate SKUs, scanned PDFs and unsupported layouts require clarification. It is not a general-purpose invoice parser.

steps.title: Compare invoice and purchase order
steps.instructions: Read the uploaded supplier invoice and purchase order, confirm each document's role from its filename and heading, compare their actual supplier and order references, quantities, prices, line amounts, currencies, and totals, and create the short review summary. Report missing or unclear information as findings; do not treat it as a match. Verify explicit invoice and order identifiers, account for every SKU row, and reconcile line arithmetic and document totals with complete Decimal precision. Inconsistent currencies, ambiguous duplicate rows, unsupported layouts or incomplete evidence require findings and employee clarification; only complete matching evidence can yield a payment-list record.

steps.title: Review invoice summary
steps.instructions: Read the invoice review summary and findings. Approve only if both documents are readable and the invoice matches the purchase order with no issues. If anything differs or is unclear, do not approve; request clarification instead.

steps.title: Add approved invoice to payment list
steps.instructions: Add the matching invoice record to the local payment list only when the employee has approved it. This records a simulated list entry; it does not make a payment.

assets.employee-instructions.txt:
Employee instructions
Compare the supplier invoice with the purchase order. Flag any difference in quantities, prices, or totals. Make a short review summary showing the amount and any issues. Ask the employee to approve matching invoices before adding them to the payment list.
